defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open Evidence Center folder tree for Q1 2026 evidence.
defects.expected_result: Hierarchy visibly includes Year -> Quarter -> Month -> Event -> Task -> Requirement -> Artifact.
defects.actual_result: The live hierarchy copy and controls show Year and Month, but Q1 quarter is not clearly exposed as a selectable folder level.
defects.recommended_fix: Expose Quarter as an explicit folder level/filter in the Evidence Center hierarchy.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open artifact AG06-IMG-001 from the Artifact Viewer route.
defects.expected_result: image preview opens the evidence artifact branch, with preview/fallback and evidence-specific traceability.
defects.actual_result: The evidence artifact route resolves as "Completed form instance record" because the URL carries form_instance_id=AG06-FI-001; the evidence-specific image preview branch is masked.
defects.recommended_fix: Prefer evidence_id/artifactId resolution over form_instance_id when type=evidence, or require explicit type precedence in Artifact Viewer.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open artifact AG06-PDF-001 from the Artifact Viewer route.
defects.expected_result: PDF preview opens the evidence artifact branch, with preview/fallback and evidence-specific traceability.
defects.actual_result: The evidence artifact route resolves as "Completed form instance record" because the URL carries form_instance_id=AG06-FI-001; the evidence-specific PDF preview branch is masked.
defects.recommended_fix: Prefer evidence_id/artifactId resolution over form_instance_id when type=evidence, or require explicit type precedence in Artifact Viewer.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open artifact AG06-DOC-001 from the Artifact Viewer route.
defects.expected_result: document fallback opens the evidence artifact branch, with preview/fallback and evidence-specific traceability.
defects.actual_result: The evidence artifact route resolves as "Completed form instance record" because the URL carries form_instance_id=AG06-FI-001; the evidence-specific document fallback branch is masked.
defects.recommended_fix: Prefer evidence_id/artifactId resolution over form_instance_id when type=evidence, or require explicit type precedence in Artifact Viewer.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open artifact AG06-SIGNED-001 from the Artifact Viewer route.
defects.expected_result: signed/certified preview opens the evidence artifact branch, with preview/fallback and evidence-specific traceability.
defects.actual_result: The evidence artifact route resolves as "Completed form instance record" because the URL carries form_instance_id=AG06-FI-001; the evidence-specific signed/certified preview branch is masked.
defects.recommended_fix: Prefer evidence_id/artifactId resolution over form_instance_id when type=evidence, or require explicit type precedence in Artifact Viewer.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open artifact AG06-MISSING-001 from the Artifact Viewer route.
defects.expected_result: missing local blob fallback opens the evidence artifact branch, with preview/fallback and evidence-specific traceability.
defects.actual_result: The evidence artifact route resolves as "Completed form instance record" because the URL carries form_instance_id=AG06-FI-001; the evidence-specific missing local blob fallback branch is masked.
defects.recommended_fix: Prefer evidence_id/artifactId resolution over form_instance_id when type=evidence, or require explicit type precedence in Artifact Viewer.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open artifact metadata whose local blob is unavailable after refresh/session loss.
defects.expected_result: Viewer clearly states file data is missing and recovery action is needed.
defects.actual_result: Missing local blob state was not clearly labeled.
defects.recommended_fix: Keep a prominent missing-blob fallback on all object-path-only artifacts.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open artifact AG06-ROUTEONLY-001 from the Artifact Viewer route.
defects.expected_result: route-only metadata fallback opens the evidence artifact branch, with preview/fallback and evidence-specific traceability.
defects.actual_result: The evidence artifact route resolves as "Completed form instance record" because the URL carries form_instance_id=AG06-FI-001; the evidence-specific route-only metadata fallback branch is masked.
defects.recommended_fix: Prefer evidence_id/artifactId resolution over form_instance_id when type=evidence, or require explicit type precedence in Artifact Viewer.

defects.steps_to_reproduce: Open Audit Mode after evidence and signed package are present; look for artifact links.
defects.expected_result: Audit Mode exposes signed/certified artifact links and survey packet evidence drill-down.
defects.actual_result: No artifact links were detectable on the initial Audit Mode view for the seeded event.
defects.recommended_fix: Make event-scoped evidence links visible and filterable from Audit Mode/survey packet entry points.
